claim: Costco's second fiscal quarter of 2024 filing showed $2B in net income, plus $58.4 billion in revenue.
summary: Costco Q2 FY2024 revenue was ~$58.4B, so the revenue part is correct, but net income was ~$1.74B, not $2B, so the claim as a whole is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Costco's second fiscal quarter of 2024 filing showed $2B in net income
sub_claims.note: From memory: Costco Q2 FY2024 (12 weeks ended Feb 18, 2024, reported March 7, 2024) net income was about $1.743B, not $2B. $2B overstates by ~$0.26B (~15%).

sub_claims.text: Costco's second fiscal quarter of 2024 filing showed $58.4 billion in revenue
sub_claims.note: From memory: Costco Q2 FY2024 total revenue was about $58.44B (~$57.33B net sales plus membership/other), matching $58.4B on rounded basis.
